items.title: RBI may raise repo rate to 6.25% by 2027 amid inflation risks: Deutsche Bank
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise the repo rate to 6.25% by mid-2027. This increase is driven by persistent inflationary pressures and robust economic growth expectations. Deutsche Bank forecasts an average consumer price index inflation of 6% in late 2026, stabilizing to 4.7% by FY28. India's GDP growth is projected above 7% for both FY27 and FY28.
